population_description: Synthetic design records supplied as the complete declared RDF-class population in each input. External legal/application eligibility and experimental edition selection are caller research assumptions, not inferred RDF facts or real-vessel certification. Records may be incomplete, inconsistent or contain unrecognized values. Conditions within the represented requirement, missing represented inputs, activation, datatype/unit/path and logical correctness remain for generated SHACL to assess. Evaluation covers finite represented inventories, not reconstruction of unrecorded real-world persons/components; this does not authorize inventing existence requirements or treating a represented missing value as compliant. Stored design-scantling and comparator records for comparable physical scantlings. regulationRequiredScantling and classificationSocietyRequiredScantling are supplied reference quantities, the latter for the corresponding non-ice-strengthened baseline described by the source. The three quantities share a supplied unit within each record; unit identity does not certify engineering equivalence. Their numeric relationship is not assumed true.
